body.name: Four-case binary-star router
body.construction: Order vertices, blocks, and pairs lexicographically. For \(\mathsf S(C)\neq\mathsf S(D)\), \(\mathsf{Route}(C,D)\) applies the first available rule: a skeleton mismatch activates the source block containing the differing arrow tail and returns the rejected ordered conditional-independence certificate; a collider mismatch activates the source block or two source blocks containing the collider parents and returns the rejected ordered conditional-independence certificate; a nonsingleton-family mismatch chooses crossing edge-support partition atoms, activates the source atom, and returns the rejected within-block regression certificate; an \(F\)-mismatch chooses a reversed \(x\to y\) with \(\mathcal N_x\neq\mathcal N_y\), selects a direction in which a block \(S\in\mathcal N_x\) is split by \(\Pi^E_y\), activates \(\{x\}\) and the first block \(T\in\Pi^E_y\) meeting but not containing \(S\), and returns the rejected regression difference between the first elements of \(S\cap T\) and \(S\setminus T\).
